en.text: Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.

footnotes.text: 149:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

zhSimplified.text: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 向耶和华唱新歌， 在圣民的会中赞美他！

zhTraditional.text: 你們要讚美耶和華！ 向耶和華唱新歌， 在聖民的會中讚美他！

en.text: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

zhSimplified.text: 愿以色列因造他的主欢喜！ 愿锡安的民因他们的王快乐！

zhTraditional.text: 願以色列因造他的主歡喜！ 願錫安的民因他們的王快樂！

en.text: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!

zhSimplified.text: 愿他们跳舞赞美他的名， 击鼓弹琴歌颂他！

zhTraditional.text: 願他們跳舞讚美他的名， 擊鼓彈琴歌頌他！

en.text: For the LORD takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.

zhSimplified.text: 因为耶和华喜爱他的百姓； 他要用救恩当作谦卑人的妆饰。

zhTraditional.text: 因為耶和華喜愛他的百姓； 他要用救恩當作謙卑人的妝飾。

en.text: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.

zhSimplified.text: 愿圣民因所得的荣耀高兴！ 愿他们在床上欢呼！

zhTraditional.text: 願聖民因所得的榮耀高興！ 願他們在床上歡呼！

en.text: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,

zhSimplified.text: 愿他们口中称赞 神为高， 手里有两刃的刀，

zhTraditional.text: 願他們口中稱讚上帝為高， 手裏有兩刃的刀，

en.text: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;

zhSimplified.text: 为要报复列邦， 刑罚万民。

zhTraditional.text: 為要報復列邦， 刑罰萬民。

en.text: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

zhSimplified.text: 要用链子捆他们的君王， 用铁镣锁他们的大臣；

zhTraditional.text: 要用鍊子捆他們的君王， 用鐵鐐鎖他們的大臣；

en.text: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise the LORD!

zhSimplified.text: 要在他们身上施行所记录的审判。 他的圣民都有这荣耀。 你们要赞美耶和华！

zhTraditional.text: 要在他們身上施行所記錄的審判。 他的聖民都有這榮耀。 你們要讚美耶和華！
